content.text: Should Claude Finder be free or paid?
There are tradeoffs. A one-time price is simple.
We decided to charge a one-time price of $29 instead of a subscription. Because users hate subscriptions for small tools.
Semantic search needs hosting costs. Let's go with a $5 monthly subscription price for the pro tier, since embeddings cost money.

I recommend IndexedDB.

We will use IndexedDB rather than chrome.storage.local for the index, because chrome.storage has a 10MB quota.
Vi har besluttet at holde alt lokalt. Ingen server.
